stories.title: Welsh Government to press for Sir Galahad files to be published
stories.summary: The Welsh Government will write to the UK Government asking for sealed records on the 1982 bombing of the Sir Galahad to be made public, the Senedd has heard. stories.title: Specsavers given green light to expand Mold High Street store
stories.summary: Specsavers has been given permission to expand its Mold High Street store into the shop next door. Flintshire County Council approved plans on 30 October to join 7 High Street with the neighbouring unit at 3-5 High Street, creating one larger store. stories.title: Senedd hears RSPCA warning over firework stress on animals
stories.summary: More than half of animal and livestock owners dread firework season, the Senedd heard on the eve of Bonfire Night. stories.title: North Wales MS raises Berwyn prison rough sleeping figures
stories.summary: Prisoners released from HMP Berwyn in Wrexham are leaving with nowhere to live, with 215 sleeping rough on their first night out last year, the Senedd has heard. stories.title: “It’s not an inquiry, it’s a review”: Welsh Government Covid panel can’t force ex-ministers to appear
stories.summary: The Welsh Government’s new review of the Covid pandemic in Wales will have no legal power to force former ministers or officials to give evidence. Dafydd Trystan Davies, Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution, announced the review-and-assurance panel for COVID-19 Wales in the Senedd on Tuesday.
